info.title: Traffic Tickets API
info.description: API for managing traffic tickets data

tags.name: Streets
tags.description: Operations related to streets and geospatial data

get.description: Get a paginated list of official streets with optional filtering

get.summary: Find streets near a GPS point with violation data
get.description: Given lat/lng, returns nearby streets with GeoJSON geometry, distance, total violations, per-year breakdown, and top violation. Uses PostGIS ST_DWithin on pcr_streets.

schema.description: Maximum number of streets to return

200.description: Nearby streets with violation data as GeoJSON

get.summary: Streets GeoJSON with violation counts (all years)
get.description: Retorna as top N ruas (union top-all-time + top-per-year) como FeatureCollection GeoJSON. Cada Feature inclui contagens por ano para filtragem client-side.

schema.description: Filter by category (exact match against traffic_tickets_catalog.category)
Filter by law article prefix (normalized: lowercase, no spaces). Matches law_code_search.
Filter to only cyclist-related violations (distance, bike lanes, door opening, etc.)
Number of top streets per group (all-time + per-year). Final count is the union.
ST_Simplify tolerance in degrees (~0.0001 = 10m). Higher = faster, less precise geometry

200.description: Streets GeoJSON with violation counts per year

get.description: SSR único: stats + evolução + breakdowns. Filtros: ?category=, ?law=, ?street_code=
Lista todos os códigos de infração com descrições para o frontend montar categorias

schema.description: Include per-year breakdown in each code

get.description: Visão enxuta para um artigo específico: total + evolução temporal por law_code. Aceita ?law=Art. 201, ?law=Art. 181, etc.
Visão completa para um logradouro específico: total, evolução temporal, categorias, infrações, agentes. Aceita ?street_code= e ?limit_violations=

schema.description: Limitar para as top N infrações (padrão: todas)
